items.title: Around 10-15 Percent of SAG-AFTRA Membership Wants AI Blocked, CEO Tells Web Summit
items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA national executive director Duncan Crabtree-Ireland told Web Summit in Lisbon that roughly 10-15% of members want the union to block AI outright and are angry it hasn't, as the guild pursues consent-and-compensation rules for digital replicas instead.

items.title: Industry Trio Launch Distinkt, AI-Powered Agency for Global Talent (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: A group of entertainment veterans have launched Distinkt in Los Angeles, a talent agency powered by AI and aimed at the mass population of unrepresented performers worldwide.

items.title: Adobe Gives Sneak Peek at Real-Time Generative AI Video Editing Feature (Project Live Set)
items.excerpt: At Adobe MAX Sneaks, Adobe showed Project Live Set, an experimental AI feature that lets creators generate and edit video while it is playing, in real time.

items.title: Adobe MAX 2026 Sneaks: all 10 projects
items.excerpt: Adobe showed 10 research projects at MAX 2026 Sneaks; RedShark details each tool, including two that can be tried now in Labs Playground.

items.title: Adobe Firefly adds Build a story and Assemble short video
items.excerpt: Adobe Firefly adds two beta workspaces, Build a story and Assemble short video, that take an idea through planned scenes and shots to a finished clip.

items.title: Adobe's AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
items.excerpt: The Verge rounds up Adobe MAX 2026 Sneaks experiments, including tools to step inside still photos as 3D spaces and to 'interview' generated characters (Project Screen Test).

items.title: CAA and Ogilvy Unveil ECHO AI Celebrity Ad Platform
items.excerpt: Ogilvy and CAA launched ECHO, a platform on WPP Open that licenses the digital likeness, voice and IP of opted-in CAA clients and turns a short shoot into a portfolio of AI-generated, media-ready ad assets.

items.title: Film Accelerator Open Cities, Run By Ex-Sundance CEO Joana Vicente & Producer Jason Kliot, Reveals First Projects
items.excerpt: Open Cities, a tech-oriented film accelerator led by former Sundance CEO Joana Vicente, selected its first 11 projects, backed by partners including Google, Luma AI, Beeble, Cinelytic and Wonder Studios. (AI is in the partner roster, lighter in the body.)

items.title: iZotope Intros Photon for AI-Powered Stem Separation and Denoising
items.excerpt: iZotope introduced Photon, a standalone app and ARA plugin using 12 custom-trained ML models for stem separation and audio/dialogue enhancement, processed locally on the user's GPU.

items.title: iQIYI Launches China's First AI Film Studio in Shanghai, with Inaugural Title "Cop in Trouble" in Production
items.excerpt: iQIYI opened a ~110 sq m AI Film Studio at its Shanghai Creative Center that pairs live-action shooting with AI post, syncing on-set footage to its NadouPro platform (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0 among ~30 models); internet feature 'Cop in Trouble' began shooting Oct. 28. Off-list press release; no allowed-domain coverage found.

items.title: Saranagati Teaser: Hombale Films Backs AI-Driven Film On ISKCON Founder's Life
items.excerpt: 'Kantara' producer Hombale Films unveiled the teaser for Saranagati, a hybrid AI feature using AI motion capture to turn performers into digital characters, set for worldwide release in August 2027. Off-list; no allowed-domain coverage found.

items.title: KBS 3년만의 대하사극 '문무'…AI 전투신 '고거전' 뛰어넘을까
items.excerpt: KBS's 30bn-won historical epic 'Munmu' (premieres Nov. 14) built its three big battles — Jupilsan, Maesoseong, Gibeolpo — with generative AI video; CP Lee Ho says AI tools improved so fast over the 18-month production that they kept swapping in newer models, using AI even more for the tidal-flat Gibeolpo battle.

items.title: '소년범' 조진웅 불쾌감, 왜 시청자 몫?..최악의 '시그널', 기어코 보낸 tvN
items.excerpt: tvN says it tested AI-based actor replacement and video-tech fixes to remove disgraced actor Cho Jin-woong from 'Signal 2' before deciding to air the series with him anyway — a real-world test case of AI face replacement failing to meet broadcast quality.

items.title: Blue Eye Samurai Studio Says Netflix Won't Allow It to Use AI: 'We're Not Allowed'
items.excerpt: Blue Spirit CCO Charles Beirnaert told TCCF Taipei the French studio is barred from using AI on its Netflix projects including Blue Eye Samurai; it has asked Netflix at what stage AI might be allowed and the answer has consistently been no.

items.title: Chinese actress Zhao Liying's lawsuit spotlights AI misuse as experts urge stronger oversight
items.excerpt: Zhao Liying has sued the operator of ByteDance's Hongguo Short Drama platform and Douyin over AI face-swapped use of her likeness in short dramas (reported claim 810,000 yuan), the highest-profile star case yet against AI-generated micro-drama production.

items.title: Labels required for AI-made dramas
items.excerpt: China's NRTA issued rules bringing AI-generated short dramas under unified national oversight for the first time, alongside live-action short dramas, including mandatory AI-content labelling. (Check vs. earlier NRTA crackdown coverage 11-05..11-10 — only new if these are the formal rules.)

items.title: Lei Lei's Hybrid Doc 'Vertigo Garden,' About a Botanist's AI-Replicated Memories, Lands at Asian Shadows Ahead of IDFA Bow
items.excerpt: Animator Lei Lei's hybrid doc reconstructs a preserved botanist's memories with AI; he describes training AI to generate footage of the same location again and again and cutting the results into a flickering effect likened to Rose Lowder. Asian Shadows takes sales ahead of IDFA.

items.title: 덱스터, AI VFX로 미디어아트 확장…'플래시백 계림' 전시
items.excerpt: Korean VFX house Dexter Studios used its AI-based VFX pipeline to re-composite subsidiary Flashbackground's immersive media-art piece 'Flashback Gyerim' for a large exhibition space at AI Content Festival 2026.

items.title: ByteDance Releases Seedance 2.5 Flash, a Faster Video Model Priced About 34% Below Seedance 2.5
items.excerpt: Volcano Engine's Seedance 2.5 Flash generates video twice as fast as Seedance 2.5 at about 0.99 yuan/sec at 720p (~34% cheaper); API access opens on Volcano Ark Nov. 15. (Published time from outlet RSS pubDate; page has no meta date.)

items.title: Hollywood warned young screenwriters about AI. Now it may be their ticket in
items.excerpt: LA film-school educators are teaching emerging screenwriters to use generative AI to develop loglines, pitches and visual pitch materials — a shift from strike-era hostility as AI spreads through screenwriting platforms.

items.title: 「生成AI」は映像業界をどう変えるか？ 金子修介監督らが語るAIと映画の関係性
items.excerpt: Gamera/Death Note director Shusuke Kaneko's new film '2126年、海の星をさがして' (opens Nov. 13) used generative AI from Smoothie Studio for its in-film game world and Shanghai/Busan pitch scenes to fit budget and schedule; he is now developing an actor-free, fully gen-AI tokusatsu project for streaming.
